title: The Dangers of Being a Dead Sea
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner explores what it means to be a vessel for God's living water, and how allowing it to flow out of us is essential to sustaining life and avoiding spiritual stagnation. Drawing from the parable of the Dead Sea, Pastor Chris reminds us that just like this vast, salty body of water, we can become "dead" if we fail to share the life-giving message and love of Jesus with others. Join Pastor Chris as he shares his own experiences of living out this principle and encourages listeners to do the same.
